proposed_widenings.name: proximity_triggered_enchantment family
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell plants a timed (10-day, non-concentration) effect on a target creature/object. Creatures of a caster-specified kind that enter within 120 ft must make a WIS saving throw. No existing family supports this: ongoing_effect only has roll_modifier/damage_on_hit operations; anchored_trigger only emits notification signals; activation resolves at cast time; triggered_reaction requires a player-facing reaction trigger. A new family (or a major anchored_trigger extension) is needed to represent proximity-triggered save gates with deterministic mechanical effects.
proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature of the chosen kind makes a Wisdom saving throw when it comes within 120 feet of the target.

proposed_widenings.name: AnchoredSignal: save_gate_with_condition
proposed_widenings.justification: Even if anchored_trigger were extended, AnchoredSignal only has audible/mental notification variants. Antipathy/Sympathy needs the release to fire a WIS save gate that applies Frightened or Charmed — a deterministic mechanical effect, not a notification.
proposed_widenings.evidence: As you cast the spell, choose whether it creates antipathy or sympathy [...] A creature of the chosen kind makes a Wisdom saving throw when it comes within 120 feet of the target.

proposed_widenings.name: Condition: frightened, charmed
proposed_widenings.justification: The current Condition type is a single-member union: 'prone'. Antipathy applies Frightened; Sympathy applies Charmed. Both are standard SRD conditions with distinct behavioral rules. The closed Condition type must be widened to include at least these two.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Antipathy: The creature has the Frightened condition. / Sympathy: The creature has the Charmed condition.

proposed_widenings.name: AnchoredFilter: creature_kind_specification
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing AnchoredFilter only models creature_exemption_list (creatures that will NOT trigger the effect). Antipathy/Sympathy uses the dual concept: specify what kind of creature IS affected. These are oppositely-scoped filters and cannot share a variant.
proposed_widenings.evidence: specify a kind of creature, such as red dragons, goblins, or vampires.

proposed_widenings.name: compelled_movement
proposed_widenings.justification: The conditions in this spell carry a mandatory movement compulsion: Frightened creatures must spend their movement fleeing; Charmed creatures must spend their movement approaching (and cannot willingly move away if within 5 ft). This is distinct from apply_condition — it's a per-turn behavioral override that modifies the creature's movement choices, not just a status flag. The v4 force_move atom captures discrete forced displacement; this is continuous compulsion over multiple turns.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The Frightened creature must use its movement on its turns to get as far away as possible from the target, moving by the safest route. / The Charmed creature must use its movement on its turns to get as close as possible to the target, moving by the safest route.

proposed_widenings.name: distance_based_repeat_save escape
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell has a positional repeat-save mechanism: if the affected creature ends its turn more than 120 ft from the target, it makes a WIS save; on success the effect ends and the creature is immune for 1 minute. The v4 repeat_save atom exists but the surface has no variant modeling a save triggered by positional condition (distance > threshold) with a timed immunity on success. This requires a new surface variant or a repeat_save subgraph extension.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If the Frightened or Charmed creature ends its turn more than 120 feet away from the target, the creature makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a successful save, the creature is no longer affected by the target. A creature that successfully saves against this effect is immune to it for 1 minute, after which it can be affected again.

proposed_widenings.name: AnchorTarget: creature_or_object
proposed_widenings.justification: Current AnchorTarget covers location (door_or_window) and area (cube). Antipathy/Sympathy anchors to a specific creature or object (Huge or smaller). The anchor IS the repulsion/attraction locus — creatures measure their 120 ft proximity to it. Neither location nor area captures a mobile or creature-typed anchor.
proposed_widenings.evidence: target one creature or object that is Huge or smaller

notes: Antipathy/Sympathy is a proximity-reactive enchantment: it plants a timed, non-concentration effect on a target creature/object, then continuously monitors for creatures of a caster-specified kind entering 120 ft, fires a WIS save gate on entry, applies Frightened or Charmed with behavioral compulsion on fail, and provides a distance-based repeat-save escape with timed immunity. This cross-cutting mechanic (persistent anchor + proximity detection + creature-kind filter + save gate + condition application + behavioral compulsion + distance-triggered repeat save with immunity) does not fit any existing payload family. anchored_trigger is the closest but its signal type covers only notifications and has no save gate or condition atom. No honest encoding is possible with the current surface vocabulary.
